summary: @jgmac1106 I utilize some elements of Workshops but there is no way a novice teacher can do the text based analysis and text based talk required with 24 different books. For comprehension I do prefer dialogical methods, which do have replicable results.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @jgmac1106 I utilize some elements of Workshops but there is no way a novice teacher can do the text based analysis and text based talk required with 24 different books. For comprehension I do prefer dialogical methods, which do have replicable results.
